string.value: A huge number of bearers of the Z-120 virus intend to leave the area right now.
These are marauders, infected military patrols and even local civilians that were hiding during the evacuation.
You are the only person close enough to the place to react to changes in the situation in time.
A big number of military vehicles is moving towards the area limit on high speed without answering on our radio calls.
We have data they are affected by the infestation. They will leave the limits of the area they were supposed to guard in five minutes.
You must intercept them before they will carry the infection to the world.
Yes, they are the vehicles. Attack them, agent!
Ok, this problem is no more, but stay online. The infestation prevention operation is at high point.
By the way, the MP squad has the hiding place of Pappers surrounded. I'm expecting the report of his arrest in a minute.
A gang of well-armed marauders have attacked the town of Fly Hill.
We found out that the town hall has a helicopter in disposal.
This craft is very small, it's all plastic, so it will be very difficult to track it with radars.
If the infected will use this chopper to escape, it will hardly be possible to bring them down, so the world will face the catastrophe.
Our experts say you have about 10 minutes to stop them.
Make it quick. You must exterminate all bandits before one of them reaches the helicopter hangar.
Not a single bastard left, well done!
The MPs have arrested Pappers. Be aware that the information about infected people being under his control is at least partially true.
A group of infected people hide amongst poisonous mushrooms near the Road river, we are about to transfer you the exact coordinates.
These mutants collect mushroom spores, which share the nature with everything in the area.
If a big amount of spores gets in the river, all territories downstream will be infested.
You have to destroy these mutants in no more then 15 minutes.
The place meets the air recon description. Begin your mission.
It seems you did the job in time. Of course, we'll have the experts to check the water cleanness downstream, but I think it will be clean.
I want to inform you proudly, that at the moment our country received the approval of the whole world to destroy the alien aggressor with surface-to-space class missiles.
It seems that the Earth salvation operation is in the final stage. Return to the base.
Infested people are leaving, you were unable to find and destroy them… We'll have to secure the area using air support.
